app.description: Path to the module whose default export is createApp(ctx), relative to the project root (the directory that holds oodlc/)

catalog.description: Directory of catalog YAML files. Default: oodlc/ itself. Only the legacy oodle.yaml layout needs it

given.description: Baseline state, stubs and body merged under every run

conditions.description: Extra conditions to probe every unknown route under, e.g. [security.no-credentials, security.injection]. Every constraint is checked on each probe

database.description: A real Postgres for the app, simulated in process with PGlite (npm i -D @electric-sql/pglite). The app connects through DATABASE_URL with its own driver; every run starts from the schema plus given.db, and each row the app writes is recorded as an internal effect (db.<table>.inserted, .updated, .deleted). See docs/decisions/0009

schema.description: SQL applied once before the runs: a .sql file, or a folder whose .sql files are applied in name order (prisma/migrations, drizzle, supabase/migrations, db/migrations). Down migrations are skipped. Relative to the project root

env.description: Environment variables set to the simulated database's URL before the app loads. Default DATABASE_URL

sealed.description: The simulation is sealed by default: real network access from the app violates the built-in oodle.sealed constraint and blocks. false opens it; { allow: [host, host:port] } lets named hosts through. See docs/decisions/0005
